BINDING_REFUSAL.why_this_is_decisive_and_not_merely_rele: The reopen condition is not a generic NEW_ORTHOGONAL_INFORMATION that a director may argue is satisfied. It names the excluded information object in its own text: '...THAT_IS_NOT_FINRA_SHORT_VOLUME'. The cell this campaign was commissioned to register IS FINRA short volume. There is no reading on which the condition is met, and a director who registered it anyway would be overturning a predecessor's recorded refusal on the exact information it excludes.
BINDING_REFUSAL.who_may_overturn_it: Not this director. Widening or vacating a recorded refusal on the information it names is a human decision, and governance_contract.json is not widened on director authority.

The director therefore also did NOT run a network reachability probe against FINRA's archive: no depth measurement can move a mechanism refusal, and measuring it would create the appearance of a live path that does not exist.

conditions.pass_if: >= 0.95 of point-in-time S&P 500 members that were DELISTED during the sample join the FINRA file on their contemporaneous ticker on >= 95% of their in-universe sessions, AND the false-match rate from ticker recycling is measured at <= 0.02 on a hand-checked sample of >= 100 delisted names, with a confidence interval.
conditions.measured_value: The certification records: 'Coverage of historically delisted members cannot be measured: there is no owned history.' Over the 24 overlapping 2026 sessions a raw ticker join covered 99.0-99.6% of CURRENT members, with 4 proven spelling artifacts (BRK/B vs BRK.B, BF/B vs BF.B, AVB-202608, EA-202608) and 1 unexplained absence (VMRK).
conditions.the_structural_point_the_director_record: Unlike the EDGAR bridge that killed R76, a historical FINRA daily file is CONTEMPORANEOUS: the 2013 file lists 2013's tickers, including names that later died, so a (date, ticker) join against a PIT panel is survivorship-safe in principle rather than a current-snapshot map. This is stated so the record is not unfairly adverse. It does not rescue the cell, because K1 fails and the mechanism is refused.

conditions.the_publication_fact_measured_by_the_dat: FINRA publishes the daily CNMS Reg SHO short-volume file AFTER the 16:00 ET close. Measured for 2026 only: HTTP Last-Modified was 1.30-1.31 hours after the close (about 17:18 ET on session s) in 34 of 34 owned files, and the owned collector retrieved 25 of 34 before the 09:30 ET open of s+1; the other 9 were late back-fills, up to 118 hours.
conditions.why_1_and_not_0: The file for session s does not exist at the close of s, so a decision timestamped at the close of s may not read it. The signal set for a decision made after the close of session s+1 may use files up to and including session s. Entry is at the open of s+2. A zero-lag rule would read a file published after the decision instant, which is leakage, and a same-session intraday rule would need an intraday mark this campaign does not own.
conditions.why_not_a_tighter_rule_using_the_17_18_E: Because that posting time is MEASURED FOR 2026 ONLY. The certification states plainly: 'NOT ESTABLISHED for any year before 2026: no owned observation of FINRA's historical posting time exists, and the Last-Modified header of a back-fetched old file is not evidence of its original posting instant.' A lag justified by a posting time nobody observed in the sample years is an assumption wearing a measurement's clothes.
conditions.pass_if: no row in the materialised feature table has an availability instant later than the decision timestamp that reads it, verified by alpha_agent.agents_v2.leakage.

the book is expressible at the NEXT OPEN after the decision session on the panel's own tradable members, and the per-name dollar allocation at a declared book size is <= 1% of that name's median dollar volume over the trailing 21 sessions, for >= 95% of selected name-sessions.
conditions.note: A five-session reversal book reselects most of its names every week. R60 measured an equity H5 cell at 0.870 one-way turnover, which at 25bp/side cost 21.9%/yr and was recorded genuinely inexpressible. Capacity, not signal, is the binding constraint on this shape.

conditions.the_budget: turnover_one_way x cost_per_side x 2 x rebalances_per_year <= 0.030 (3.00%/yr), with equity_cost_bps_per_side = 25 and rebalances_per_year = 252/5 = 50.4.
conditions.why_a_net_cost_budget_and_not_the_0_40_t: The R60 census records that the scalar 0.40 one-way turnover ceiling is TWO different economic constraints misspecified as one, and that it destroyed two of four non-equity cells before any return was scored. The replacement is a per-cell NET COST budget, pinned BEFORE any turnover is seen, which is the condition R60 attached to using it at all. It is pinned here, in a frozen document, before any executor exists.
conditions.borrow: The census records this cell long_short=false, so the book is LONG-ONLY and needs NO borrow and pays no borrow cost. If any future re-specification makes it long-short, that is a NEW experiment with a NEW id charged to the burden, and it must add a measured borrow cost for the short leg on the actual names - hard-to-borrow names are exactly the high-short-volume names this signal conditions on, so an assumed flat borrow would be the cheapest possible way to manufacture an edge.
conditions.on_fail: HALT BEFORE MEASUREMENT. The budget is not relaxed.

conditions.pass_if: >= 400 in-universe decision-sessions with a non-null short-volume share in EACH of the discovery, validation and lockbox layers.
conditions.on_fail: HALT BEFORE MEASUREMENT as UNDERPOWERED, annotated NOT DEAD, following the R60 precedent that an underpowered null must never be reported as evidence of absence.

conditions.pass_if: |Newey-West t| >= 3.00 on the mean net excess return at the LOCKBOX stage, sign equal to the frozen expected sign, AFTER the Benjamini-Hochberg correction the gate applies at the binding burden denominator.
conditions.on_fail: NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE. Borderline is a fail; 2.99 is a fail. A wrong sign is a kill and never a re-specification.
conditions.owner: alpha_agent.r59.engines.gate over alpha_agent.r57.engine. ONE statistic. No IC, no Sharpe, no hit rate is promoted to a decision role.

THE_EXHAUSTIVE_INFORMATION_CENSUS_THE_DI.method: ResearchMemory(read_only=True).list_hypotheses(limit=1000000) grouped by information_family. A pure read.
THE_EXHAUSTIVE_INFORMATION_CENSUS_THE_DI.finding: 8,231 of 8,445 rows (97.5%) are PRICE_STATE. EVERY other information family in the estate is settled - there is not one information family with an unsettled row. The largest non-price families are MACRO_OBSERVATION (32), CFTC_POSITIONING (32), CBOE_INDEX (7), EXCHANGE_OPEN_INTEREST (6). SHORT_VOLUME has exactly 1, and it is FORWARD_FROZEN.
THE_EXHAUSTIVE_INFORMATION_CENSUS_THE_DI.the_honest_conclusion: There is no admissible non-equity cell in this estate today, and the obstruction is an ABSENCE OF INFORMATION, not a rule. Widening the diversity gate would unblock nothing, which is why the director does not ask for it. This independently reproduces R74's BLOCKED_ON_DATA finding by a different route, one campaign later, and should now be treated as a settled property of the estate rather than a question each new campaign re-opens.

what_the_director_will_NOT_do_to_produce: Relabel prosecuted futures returns into an empty information_family to reach a burden-0 key (refused: R67 precedent, and probe C2_P6 shows the director found the loophole and declined it).
Re-run a settled mechanism in a new asset class and call the universe change new information (refused: R73 durable ruling REFUSED_A_UNIVERSE_IS_NOT_NEW_INFORMATION, R74 C11/C12).
Re-test a FORWARD_FROZEN mechanism backward to fill a diversity line (refused: it destroys the only clean evidence the estate is still accruing).
Request a data purchase (forbidden to this campaign, and the operator's instruction 1 forbids even a WRDS approval request).

Pad the campaign with known-dead cells so a diversity line reads better. The contract forbids re-prosecuting settled families more strongly than it requires diversity, and the budget is a ceiling, not a target.

DIVERSITY_GATE_POSITION_STATED_HONESTLY.position: NOT MET, with ZERO denominator. This campaign pre-registers zero experiments, so the gate has nothing to bind. The operator's instruction that an equity-only agenda is a failure is satisfied in the only honest way available: the campaign is not equity-only, it is empty, and it says so.
DIVERSITY_GATE_POSITION_STATED_HONESTLY.escalated: This is the fourth consecutive campaign (R73, R74, R76, R77) in which the diversity gate could only be satisfied by re-prosecuting a settled family. The director does NOT widen governance_contract.json or research_director_protocol.json on his own authority and, following R74, does not ask for a widening either - because widening would unblock nothing. The escalation is the ROOT-CAUSE DEFECT below, which is actionable.

ROOT_CAUSE_DEFECT_R77_DEFECT_1.name: THE_DIRECTOR_BRIEF_DOES_NOT_JOIN_THE_DURABLE_RULING_STORE
ROOT_CAUSE_DEFECT_R77_DEFECT_1.severity: GOVERNANCE_HIGH - it caused this entire campaign to be commissioned on two cells that were already durably refused.
ROOT_CAUSE_DEFECT_R77_DEFECT_1.previously_reported_as: R73_DEFECT_1, 'the director brief's queued_hypotheses projection still does not join the director_rulings store'. Reported by R73, restated as unchanged by R74, and still unfixed. This is its fourth sighting and the first time it has caused a full campaign to be mis-commissioned.

proof_in_code.what_it_does: _director_brief copies census['queued_hypotheses'] into the brief, keeping only rank, proposal, agent, asset_class, family and horizon_sessions.
proof_in_code.what_it_never_calls: pipe.mem.director_rulings(). The durable refusal store is never read when the agenda queue is projected.
proof_in_code.second_order_loss: The projection also DROPS the census's own R68_MECHANISM_CHECK block, which does exist on ranks 1-5. So the brief is strictly LESS informative about novelty than the census file it is built from, and a director who obeys the context contract and reads only the brief cannot see that rank 10 or rank 12 was ever ruled on.

ROOT_CAUSE_DEFECT_R77_DEFECT_1.observed_consequence: BRIEF_director_r77.json lists rank 10 and rank 12 in queued_hypotheses with no ruling, no reopen condition and no settled-sibling count, while R59 memory holds a REFUSED_AS_ALREADY_MEASURED ruling naming rank 12 and a CONSIDERED_AND_NOT_PROPOSED ruling naming rank 10.
ROOT_CAUSE_DEFECT_R77_DEFECT_1.the_fix_the_director_recommends_and_does: Join director_rulings into the brief's queued_hypotheses projection and drop, or clearly flag, any queued proposal whose (asset_class, economic_family) carries a ruling, carrying the verdict, blocker_reason and reopen_condition beside it. This is a code change in alpha_agent/agents_v2/briefs.py and is not this campaign's scope; the director reports it and does not edit it.
ROOT_CAUSE_DEFECT_R77_DEFECT_1.why_the_durable_ruling_the_director_wrot: Recording R77's rulings mechanism-scoped makes them readable, but the BRIEF still will not read them. Without the briefs.py join, a fifth campaign will be handed rank 10 and rank 12 again.

SECONDARY_DEFECT_R77_DEFECT_2.name: R76_RECORDED_UNEXAMINED_AGAINST_THE_TRANSCRIPT_NOT_THE_RULING_STORE
SECONDARY_DEFECT_R77_DEFECT_2.statement: CAMPAIGN_R76_OUTCOME.json#UNEXAMINED_NOT_REFUSED asserts of rank 12: 'It is not settled and is available to the next campaign.' The first clause is defensible (there is no settled HYPOTHESIS row on the four-part key). The second is false: a durable director RULING made it unavailable three campaigns earlier.
SECONDARY_DEFECT_R77_DEFECT_2.the_general_lesson: 'No campaign in my transcript ruled on X' and 'the estate has not ruled on X' are different claims, and only the second one licenses acting. An UNEXAMINED note should be required to cite a director_rulings() read before it may say 'available to the next campaign'.
SECONDARY_DEFECT_R77_DEFECT_2.not_a_criticism_of_R76s_honesty: R76's director explicitly declined to assert a verdict he had not measured, which was the right instinct. The defect is that the available/unavailable claim was made anyway, from the wrong source.

The owning agent each cell WOULD have had is recorded on the cell itself (reversal-signal-agent for R77_C1, trend-breadth-signal-agent for R77_C2) and both routings were verified against contracts.families_for, so that a future human who vacates a refusal does not have to re-derive them.

SPAWN_GATE_CONFLICT_R77_DEFECT_3.name: THE_SPAWN_GATE_CANNOT_READ_A_DIRECTOR_REFUSAL_EITHER
SPAWN_GATE_CONFLICT_R77_DEFECT_3.severity: OPERATIONAL - it would dispatch a role this spec explicitly refuses to commission.
SPAWN_GATE_CONFLICT_R77_DEFECT_3.measured_by: scripts/agents_v2_brief.py --spawn-plan against this frozen spec, run by the director after freezing it.
SPAWN_GATE_CONFLICT_R77_DEFECT_3.what_the_gate_returns: spawn = [quant-research-director, data-foundation-agent]; data-foundation-agent decision SPAWN, reason FOUNDATION_STAGE_NOT_YET_SATISFIED, facts {data_certified: false}, because requires.datasets names FINRA_SHORT_VOLUME_PIT_V2 and it is not certified, so substrate_missing.datasets = [FINRA_SHORT_VOLUME_PIT_V2].
SPAWN_GATE_CONFLICT_R77_DEFECT_3.the_conflict: This spec's ROLES.skip records data-foundation-agent as NOT to be spawned, reason NO_ADMISSIBLE_CELL_TO_CERTIFY_SUBSTRATE_FOR. The spawn gate derives its answer mechanically from substrate_missing and never reads the spec's ROLES block or the director-ruling store, so it reaches the opposite conclusion.
SPAWN_GATE_CONFLICT_R77_DEFECT_3.why_the_director_did_not_dodge_it_by_edi: Emptying requires.datasets would make the gate silent and compliant, but the operator explicitly required the FINRA short-volume dataset id to be NAMED there, and removing it to manage a gate's output would be tuning a declaration to produce a desired dispatch. The declaration is correct: the cell genuinely would need that dataset. The gate's reading of it is what is wrong.
SPAWN_GATE_CONFLICT_R77_DEFECT_3.THE_BINDING_INSTRUCTION_FOR_THE_SESSION_: DO NOT DISPATCH data-foundation-agent for this campaign. The director's ROLES.skip governs. There is no D1 in COMMISSIONED_WORK (it is an empty object), so a data-foundation-agent spawned here would receive no commissioned work and would be certifying a dataset for a mechanism that is durably refused - which is exactly the wasted certification R73_D1 and R75_D1 already demonstrate.
SPAWN_GATE_CONFLICT_R77_DEFECT_3.the_pattern_this_shares_with_R77_DEFECT_: Both are mechanical projections over research memory that cannot see a director's ruling. briefs.py:353-358 re-queues refused cells; routing.spawn_plan re-commissions refused substrate. A ruling that its own tooling cannot read is a ruling that only holds while a human is watching.
SPAWN_GATE_CONFLICT_R77_DEFECT_3.recommended_fix_not_applied: spawn_plan should treat a dataset named in requires as NOT-to-be-certified when the campaign spec pre-registers zero experiments and COMMISSIONED_WORK is empty, or should consult director_rulings for the consuming mechanism. A code change; not this campaign's scope.

requires.why: alpha_agent.agents_v2.briefs._foundation_done falls back to the ESTATE-WIDE answer when a spec declares nothing, which is how R76's spawn gate skipped the very role that spec commissioned. This block is declared so the gate reads THIS campaign's substrate need rather than the estate's. Because both cells are refused, the two dataset ids below are declared as REQUIRED-AND-ABSENT: they are what the cells would need, and naming them makes the spawn gate report the substrate as missing rather than silently satisfied. Nothing here commissions a certification, mints an id, charges burden or relaxes a kill condition.
